name: Project Accelerate
decision_label: Rezoning petition withdrawn before scheduled vote
summary: Developers withdrew the five-building Project Accelerate rezoning after sustained public opposition and an indication that town commissioners would reject it.
proposal_description: The proposal sought industrial rezoning for a multi-building data-center campus on East John Street near Interstate 485 in Matthews.

proposed_scale.label: Proposed electricity request
proposed_scale.value: Up to 600 MW reported; not built capacity

site_afterlife: The withdrawal left options open. No stable alternative use or sufficiently long post-period is established in this release.
evidence_note: Recent disposition; map and timeline eligible, economic comparison not ready. The developer described the withdrawal as allowing time to explore options.

timeline.title: Project Accelerate enters public review
timeline.summary: A large campus proposal on East John Street generated immediate public interest and concern.

timeline.title: Organized opposition grows
timeline.summary: Residents raised concerns about power, water, noise, and town character and organized a large petition.

timeline.title: Developers withdraw rezoning request
timeline.summary: The project was pulled before a scheduled decision after the mayor indicated it faced defeat.
